requests.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: matching rear-view game cutout source on genuinely transparent background. Input image 1 is the accepted front design and style reference ONLY; do not modify it. Draw the exact same Grave Surgeon from the rear three-quarter view, facing upper-left in the image, following the game's 2:1 isometric board projection. A thin hooded undead plague surgeon in ragged muted brown robes, bone beaked skull mask mostly hidden from behind, tied leather belt with small spare vials, skeletal wrapped wrists, worn wrapped boots. His right hand carries the SAME long pale toothed bone saw down at his side; his left hand holds the SAME small green round vial. From this rear view the saw is on the viewer's RIGHT and the vial on the viewer's LEFT. Preserve the hunched narrow anatomy, asymmetrical ragged hem, brown cloth values, precise dark outline, pixel-readable painterly texture and scale proportions of the reference. Full body centered with clear space on all sides and visible heel contacts; elevated rear view, not flat side or front. Relaxed matching rest pose. No extra equipment, no second character, no labels, no shadows, no ground, no checkerboard. Preserve real alpha transparency.
requests.disposition: Rejected before rigging: the upper-left viewpoint does not match the shared upper-right rear-facing policy. Superseded by rear_v2_generated.png in generation_addendum.json; no runtime pixels selected.

requests.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: hidden undergarment material for an editable 2D game character rig. Keep the shoulders, elbows, wrists, hips, knees and boots in exactly the same places and the same proportions as the original, including the 2:1 three-quarter projection facing lower-left. Plain head silhouette is enough; it will not be used. Narrow lean undead build, dark brown rough cloth with bandage-wrapped sleeves and lower legs, same painterly pixel-readable shading and dark outlines. Bare hands may remain but no tools. No new armor or decorations. Full-body single character on genuinely transparent alpha, no checkerboard, ground or shadow. This source will only supply small concealed cloth overlaps and hidden trouser material; all visible original front art remains unchanged.
requests.disposition: Rejected runtime input: RGB painted checkerboard. Retained as alpha repair target.
